title: Transmission lowers US generation costs, but generator incentives are not aligned
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The US electricity grid is rapidly evolving with the entry of low-cost renewable electricity. As a result, new supply is not spatially matched to demand, and the transmission network has become more strained. Better market integration could thus lower US generation costs. We document that eliminating interregional constraints would have reduced electricity generation costs across the lower US 48 states by $5.8 to 7.1 billion in 2022 and $3.4 to 5.0 billion in 2023. But market integration creates winners and losers among generation companies, and we show that producers in some regions have incentives to delay or block grid integration despite the overall system benefits.
abstract_zh: 随着低成本可再生电力的进入，美国电网正在快速演变。由此，新增供给与需求在空间上并不匹配，输电网络的压力日益加大。更好的市场一体化因此有望降低美国的发电成本。我们记录到，在2022年消除区域间约束本可使美国本土48个州的发电成本降低58亿至71亿美元，在2023年降低34亿至50亿美元。但市场一体化会在发电企业之间制造赢家和输家，我们表明，尽管整体系统层面存在收益，部分地区的生产商仍有动机拖延或阻挠电网一体化。

title: Navigating the 'Problem from Hell': A Guide to Climate Damages
abstract: Multiple lines of research aim to quantify the economic impacts of climate change. We show that the effects of climate change on economic activity depend on how climate change alters weather across time and space. Changes in contemporary weather have direct effects on output; changes in past weather and in expectations of future weather induce adaptation; and changes in weather elsewhere around the globe introduce a general equilibrium effect. Using this framework, we argue that estimation of climate impacts faces a trilemma. A methodology can have at most two of: (i) robustness to a particular economic model’s structure, (ii) interpretation as effects of persistent, widespread, anticipated climate change, and (iii) quasi-experimental identification. We summarize the literature on climate damages in light of the trilemma. A solid body of knowledge has developed around direct effects, and recent work has made substantial progress towards understanding adaptation and spatial spillovers. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 多条研究路线旨在量化气候变化的经济影响。我们表明，气候变化对经济活动的影响取决于其如何在时间和空间上改变天气。当前天气的变化对产出有直接影响；过去天气的变化以及对未来天气的预期会引发适应行为；全球其他地区天气的变化则带来一般均衡效应。基于这一框架，我们认为气候影响的估计面临一个三难困境：一种方法至多只能同时满足以下三项中的两项：(i) 对特定经济模型结构的稳健性，(ii) 可解释为持续、广泛且可预期的气候变化的效应，以及(iii) 准实验识别。我们依据这一三难困境梳理了气候损害的文献。围绕直接效应已形成扎实的知识体系，近期研究在理解适应行为与空间溢出效应方面也取得了实质进展。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Cutting Costs or Cutting Corners: Asset Reallocation in Oil and Gas Production
abstract: Reallocation of assets across firms can lead to efficiency gains, but it can also lead to distortions via rent-seeking. We examine the link between asset reallocation and rent-seeking enabled by differences in the expected cost of environmental liabilities. Focusing on the US oil and gas industry, we develop a conceptual framework that incorporates both firm specialization in well types and the judgment-proof problem, by which undercapitalized firms can avoid environmental liabilities. We then build a novel dataset with hundreds of thousands of well transfers over 1992 to 2023, showing that oil and gas wells are transferred frequently, particularly as they age and their revenues decline. Moreover, low-value wells are especially likely to be transferred to low-value firms. Transferred wells produce similar amounts in later years, but are less likely to be plugged – thus posing greater environmental risk. We conclude with policy implications related to well plugging, bonding requirements, and decarbonization. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 企业之间的资产再配置可能带来效率提升，但也可能通过寻租导致扭曲。我们考察了环境负债预期成本差异所促成的资产再配置与寻租之间的联系。以美国石油和天然气行业为研究对象，我们构建了一个概念框架，同时纳入了企业在油井类型上的专业化，以及资本不足企业可以逃避环境负债的“无偿付能力”问题。随后，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，涵盖1992年至2023年间数十万次油井转让，结果表明油气井转让十分频繁，尤其是在油井老化、收入下降之后。此外，低价值油井尤其容易被转让给低价值企业。被转让的油井在之后几年的产量相近，但被封井的可能性更低，因此带来了更大的环境风险。最后，我们提出了与油井封堵、保证金要求和脱碳相关的政策启示。美国国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可免费从www.nber.org下载本文。

title: Power Flows: Transmission Lines, Allocative Efficiency, and Corporate Profits
abstract: Accelerated investment in electricity transmission could reduce total costs and enhance renewable integration. I document static allocative inefficiencies induced by incomplete market integration in 2 major US markets; these have risen over time and totaled $2 billion in 2022. I also argue that estimating firm-level impacts is important, as incumbents may have the power to block new lines and other reforms. I show that 4 firms would have experienced a collective $1.3 billion drop in net revenues in 2022 had the market been integrated, and there are reports of some of these firms blocking transmission projects. (JEL D22, D24, L13, L94, Q42, Q48)
abstract_zh: 加快电力输电投资可以降低总成本并增强可再生能源的并网能力。我记录了美国2个主要市场中因市场一体化不完全而产生的静态配置效率损失；这些损失随时间不断上升，并在2022年合计达20亿美元。我还认为，估计企业层面的影响十分重要，因为既有企业可能有能力阻挠新建线路及其他改革。我表明，如果当时市场已实现一体化，4家企业在2022年的净收入将共同减少13亿美元，并且有报道显示其中部分企业曾阻挠输电项目。（JEL D22, D24, L13, L94, Q42, Q48）

title: Measurement-based carbon intensity of US offshore oil and gas production
abstract: The United States (US) produces oil and gas from six offshore regions: the North Slope of Alaska, Cook Inlet in Alaska, offshore California, and three Gulf of Mexico (GOM) sub-regions: state shallow, federal shallow, and deep waters. Measurement-based assessment of direct greenhouse gas emissions from this production can provide real-world information on carbon emissions to inform decisions on current and future production. In evaluating the climate impact of production, the carbon intensity (CI, the ratio of greenhouse gases emitted compared to the energy of fuels produced) is often used, though it is rarely quantified with measurements. Here, we complete an observational evaluation of the US offshore sector and present the largest current set of measurement-based CIs. We collected airborne measurements of methane, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen oxides from the North Slope, Cook Inlet, and California and combined with prior GOM results. For Alaska and California, we found emissions agree with facility-level inventories, however, the inventories miss some facilities. The US offshore CI, on a 100 year GWP basis, is 5.7 g CO2e/MJ[4.5, 6.8, 95% confidence interval]. This is greater than double the CI based on the national US inventory, with the discrepancy attributed primarily to methane emissions from GOM shallow waters, with a methane dominated CI of 16[12, 22] for GOM federal shallow waters and 43[25–65] for state shallow waters. Regional intensities vary, with carbon dioxide emissions largely responsible for CI on the North Slope 11[7.5, 15], in Cook Inlet 22[13, 34], offshore California 7.2[3.2, 13], and in GOM deep waters 1.1[1.0, 1.1]. These observations indicate offshore operations outside of the GOM in the US have modest methane emissions, but the CI can still be elevated due to direct carbon dioxide emissions. Accurate assessment of different offshore basins, with differing characteristics and practices, is important for the climate considerations of expanded production.
abstract_zh: 美国在六个海上区域开采石油和天然气：阿拉斯加北坡、阿拉斯加库克湾、加利福尼亚近海，以及墨西哥湾（GOM）的三个子区域：州属浅水区、联邦浅水区和深水区。对这些生产活动直接温室气体排放进行基于测量的评估，可以提供关于碳排放的真实信息，为当前及未来的生产决策提供依据。在评估生产活动的气候影响时，常用碳强度（CI，即所排放温室气体与所生产燃料能量之比）这一指标，但它很少通过测量来量化。在此，我们完成了对美国海上行业的观测评估，并给出了目前规模最大的一组基于测量的碳强度。我们在阿拉斯加北坡、库克湾和加利福尼亚进行了机载测量，采集甲烷、二氧化碳和氮氧化物数据，并与此前墨西哥湾的研究结果相结合。对于阿拉斯加和加利福尼亚，我们发现排放量与设施层面的清单相符，但清单遗漏了部分设施。按100年全球增温潜势（GWP）计算，美国海上碳强度为5.7 g CO2e/MJ［95%置信区间4.5，6.8］，是基于美国国家清单所得碳强度的两倍多，差异主要归因于墨西哥湾浅水区的甲烷排放。墨西哥湾联邦浅水区的甲烷主导型碳强度为16［12，22］，州属浅水区为43［25–65］。各地区强度有所不同：北坡的碳强度为11［7.5，15］，库克湾为22［13，34］，加州近海为7.2［3.2，13］，墨西哥湾深水区为1.1［1.0，1.1］，其中二氧化碳排放在北坡、库克湾、加州近海和墨西哥湾深水区的碳强度中占主要部分。这些观测表明，美国墨西哥湾以外的海上作业甲烷排放量不大，但由于直接的二氧化碳排放，碳强度仍然可能偏高。准确评估不同特征和作业方式的海上盆地，对于扩大生产的气候考量十分重要。

title: Power system decarbonization: A comparison between carbon taxes and forcing coal power plant retirements
abstract: The U.S. power system faces a 2035 decarbonization target, though the exact pathway to the target remains unclear. Policy instruments, like carbon taxes and forcing coal plants to retire through various mechanisms, could help achieve the target. It is critical to analyze and compare decarbonization policies as different policies lead to different costs, emissions pathways, and political challenges. In this paper, we explore the ramifications of adopting alternative decarbonization policies. We assume a particular carbon tax to be the benchmark policy and compare it to alternative carbon tax and forced coal retirement policies in terms of emissions and costs. We use a power system dispatch model that co-optimizes unit commitment, energy, and frequency regulation capacity to simulate system evolution over multiple years, including retirements and renewables/storage expansion, under each policy. Our case study highlights the trade-offs between policies. We find that, counter-intuitively, higher carbon taxes do not always achieve lower emissions due to the complexity of dispatch, resulting profits and retirements, and the addition of renewables/storage. In contrast, forced coal retirements result in lower power system costs but higher emissions than the benchmark policy, with a large range of possible outcomes across different retirement cases.
abstract_zh: 美国电力系统面临2035年脱碳目标，但实现该目标的具体路径仍不清晰。碳税以及通过各种机制迫使燃煤电厂退役等政策工具，都有助于实现这一目标。由于不同政策会导致不同的成本、排放路径和政治挑战，分析并比较各项脱碳政策至关重要。本文探讨了采用不同脱碳政策的后果。我们将某一特定碳税设定为基准政策，并在排放与成本方面将其与其他碳税方案及强制燃煤电厂退役的政策进行比较。我们使用一个电力系统调度模型，同时优化机组组合、电能和调频容量，以模拟各政策下包括退役以及可再生能源和储能扩张在内的多年系统演化。我们的案例研究突显了各政策之间的权衡。我们发现，违反直觉的是，较高的碳税并不总能带来更低的排放，原因在于调度的复杂性、由此产生的利润与退役情况，以及可再生能源和储能的增加。相比之下，强制燃煤电厂退役使电力系统成本更低，但排放高于基准政策，且在不同退役情景下结果范围很大。

title: Spillovers from Ancillary Services to Wholesale Energy Markets
abstract: In electricity markets, generators are rewarded for providing energy and for enabling grid reliability. The two functions are compensated separately: with energy market payments and ancillary services market payments. We provide evidence of changes in the generation mix in the energy market that are driven by exogenous changes in an ancillary services market. We provide a theoretical framework and quasi‐experimental evidence for understanding the mechanism: it results from the multi‐product nature of power plants combined with discontinuities in costs. Although much research focuses solely on the energy market, our results suggest that spillovers between the two markets are important.
abstract_zh: 在电力市场中，发电企业既因提供电能而获得报酬，也因保障电网可靠性而获得报酬。这两种功能分别进行补偿：一是通过电能市场支付，二是通过辅助服务市场支付。我们提供证据表明，辅助服务市场的外生变化会推动电能市场中发电结构的变化。我们提出了一个理论框架，并给出准自然实验证据，以理解其作用机制：这种机制源于发电厂的多产品属性与成本的不连续性相结合。尽管大量研究只关注电能市场，但我们的结果表明，两个市场之间的溢出效应十分重要。

title: Excess methane emissions from shallow water platforms elevate the carbon intensity of US Gulf of Mexico oil and gas production
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
The Gulf of Mexico is the largest offshore fossil fuel production basin in the United States. Decisions on expanding production in the region legally depend on assessments of the climate impact of new growth. Here, we collect airborne observations and combine them with previous surveys and inventories to estimate the climate impact of current field operations. We evaluate all major on-site greenhouse gas emissions, carbon dioxide (CO
2
) from combustion, and methane from losses and venting. Using these findings, we estimate the climate impact per unit of energy of produced oil and gas (the carbon intensity). We find high methane emissions (0.60 Tg/y [0.41 to 0.81, 95% confidence interval]) exceeding inventories. This elevates the average CI of the basin to 5.3 g CO
2
e/MJ [4.1 to 6.7] (100-y horizon) over twice the inventories. The CI across the Gulf varies, with deep water production exhibiting a low CI dominated by combustion emissions (1.1 g CO
2
e/MJ), while shallow federal and state waters exhibit an extraordinarily high CI (16 and 43 g CO
2
e/MJ) primarily driven by methane emissions from central hub facilities (intermediaries for gathering and processing). This shows that production in shallow waters, as currently operated, has outsized climate impact. To mitigate these climate impacts, methane emissions in shallow waters must be addressed through efficient flaring instead of venting and repair, refurbishment, or abandonment of poorly maintained infrastructure. We demonstrate an approach to evaluate the CI of fossil fuel production using observations, considering all direct production emissions while allocating to all fossil products.
abstract_zh: 墨西哥湾是美国最大的海上化石燃料生产盆地。该地区扩大生产的决定在法律上依赖于对新增产量气候影响的评估。在此，我们收集了机载观测数据，并将其与既往调查和清单相结合，以估算当前现场作业的气候影响。我们评估了所有主要的现场温室气体排放，包括燃烧产生的二氧化碳（CO2）以及泄漏和排放产生的甲烷。基于这些发现，我们估算了每单位已生产油气能量的气候影响（即碳强度）。我们发现甲烷排放量很高（0.60 Tg/y［0.41至0.81，95%置信区间］），超过了清单数据。这使该盆地的平均碳强度升至5.3 g CO2e/MJ［4.1至6.7］（100年时间尺度），是清单数据的两倍多。墨西哥湾各地的碳强度存在差异：深水生产的碳强度较低，主要由燃烧排放主导（1.1 g CO2e/MJ），而联邦浅水区和州属浅水区则表现出极高的碳强度（分别为16和43 g CO2e/MJ），主要由中心枢纽设施（负责集输和处理的中间环节）的甲烷排放所驱动。这表明，按目前的运营方式，浅水区生产的气候影响不成比例地大。为减轻这些气候影响，必须通过高效燃烧（而非排放）处理浅水区的甲烷排放，并对维护不善的基础设施进行修复、翻新或弃置。我们展示了一种利用观测数据评估化石燃料生产碳强度的方法，该方法考虑了所有直接生产排放，并将其分摊至所有化石产品。

title: Transmission Impossible? Prospects for Decarbonizing the US Grid
abstract: Encouraged by the declining cost of grid-scale renewables, recent analyses conclude that the United States could reach net zero carbon dioxide emissions by 2050 at relatively low cost using currently available technologies. While the cost of renewable generation has declined dramatically, integrating these renewables would require a large expansion in transmission to deliver that power. Already there is growing evidence that the United States has insufficient transmission capacity, and current levels of annual investment are well below what would be required for a renewables-dominated system. We describe a variety of challenges that make it difficult to build new transmission and potential policy responses to mitigate them, as well as possible substitutes for some new transmission capacity.
abstract_zh: 在电网规模可再生能源成本下降的鼓舞下，近期的分析得出结论：美国有望利用现有技术，以相对较低的成本于2050年实现二氧化碳净零排放。尽管可再生发电成本已大幅下降，但要整合这些可再生能源，需要大幅扩建输电网络以输送电力。已有越来越多的证据表明，美国的输电能力不足，而当前的年度投资水平远低于以可再生能源为主的系统所需的水平。我们描述了使新建输电设施变得困难的多种挑战，以及缓解这些挑战的潜在政策应对措施，并讨论了可替代部分新增输电能力的可能方案。

title: Long-term Impacts of Energy Storage Providing Regulation on Power Plant Retirements and System Emissions
venue: Proceedings of the Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences
abstract: Energy storage can provide a variety of economic and reliability benefits to the grid; however, the overall environmental impacts of storage are not always positive, as some studies have shown. In this paper, we explore the long-term impacts of using storage to provide frequency regulation. Specifically, using an optimization model that co-optimizes unit commitment, energy, and regulation capacity, we explore the effect of increasing penetrations of regulation-providing storage on dispatch, prices, profit, retirements, and long-term system-wide CO2 emissions. We also investigate how the impacts change when retired generators are replaced by renewables. We find that storage can lead to increases or decreases in emissions, depending on system parameters and whether renewables replace retired capacity. Additionally, we find that long-term impacts can be in different directions than short-term impacts. This points to the need for new mechanisms to ensure desired environmental outcomes are achieved when using so-called "green" technologies.
abstract_zh: 储能可为电网带来多种经济和可靠性效益；然而，正如一些研究所示，储能的整体环境影响并不总是正面的。本文探讨了利用储能提供频率调节的长期影响。具体而言，我们使用一个同时优化机组组合、电能和调节容量的优化模型，考察了提供调节服务的储能渗透率提高对调度、价格、利润、退役以及长期全系统二氧化碳排放的影响。我们还研究了当退役发电机组被可再生能源替代时，这些影响如何变化。我们发现，储能既可能增加也可能减少排放，具体取决于系统参数以及退役容量是否由可再生能源替代。此外，我们发现长期影响的方向可能与短期影响不同。这表明，在使用所谓“绿色”技术时，需要新的机制来确保实现预期的环境结果。

title: Who Will Pay for Legacy Utility Costs?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Inequality, Information Failures, and Air Pollution
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract:
Research spanning several disciplines has repeatedly documented disproportionate pollution exposure among the poor and communities of color. Among the various proposed causes of this pattern, those that have received the most attention are income inequality, discrimination, and firm costs (of inputs and regulatory compliance). We argue that an additional channel – information – is likely to play an important role in generating disparities in pollution exposure. We present multiple reasons for a tendency to underestimate pollution burdens, as well as empirical evidence that this underestimation can disproportionately affect low-income households. Using a model of housing choice, we then derive conditions under which “hidden” pollution leads to an inequality – even when all households face the same lack of information. This inequality arises because households sort according to known pollution and other disamenities, which we show are positively correlated with hidden pollution. To help bridge the gap between environmental justice and economics, we discuss the relationship between hidden information and three different distributional measures: exposure to pollution; exposure to hidden pollution; and welfare loss due to hidden pollution.
Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh:
多个学科的研究反复记录了穷人和有色人种社区承受着不成比例的污染暴露。在已提出的各种成因中，最受关注的是收入不平等、歧视以及企业成本（包括投入品成本和合规成本）。我们认为，另一渠道——信息——很可能在造成污染暴露差异方面发挥重要作用。我们提出了低估污染负担的多种原因，并给出了实证证据，表明这种低估可能对低收入家庭产生不成比例的影响。借助一个住房选择模型，我们推导出即使所有家庭面临的信息缺失相同，“隐性”污染仍会导致不平等的条件。这种不平等源于家庭会根据已知污染及其他不利环境因素进行分类，而我们表明这些因素与隐性污染呈正相关。为了帮助弥合环境正义与经济学之间的鸿沟，我们讨论了隐性信息与三种不同分配衡量指标之间的关系：污染暴露、隐性污染暴露，以及隐性污染导致的福利损失。

title: Are Energy Executives Rewarded For Luck?
abstract:
In this paper, we examine executive compensation data from 78 major U.S. oil and gas companies over a 24-year period. Perhaps in no other industry are the fortunes of so many executives so dependent on a single global commodity price. We find that a 10% increase in oil prices is associated with a 2% increase in executive compensation. This oil price effect holds for both CEOs and non-CEOs and separately for several different individual components of compensation, including bonuses.
We find that the oil price effect is larger in companies with more insiders on the board, and asymmetric, with executive compensation rising with increasing oil prices more than it falls with decreasing oil prices. We then discuss potential mechanisms drawn from the broader existing literature on executive compensation.
abstract_zh:
本文考察了美国78家主要石油和天然气公司24年间的高管薪酬数据。或许在其他行业中，如此多高管的财富都不如此依赖于单一的全球大宗商品价格。我们发现，油价每上涨10%，高管薪酬相应增加2%。这一油价效应对首席执行官和非首席执行官均成立，并且对薪酬的若干不同组成部分（包括奖金）分别成立。
我们发现，油价效应在董事会内部人较多的公司中更大，并且是不对称的：油价上涨时高管薪酬的增幅大于油价下跌时的降幅。随后，我们结合现有的高管薪酬文献，讨论了可能的作用机制。

title: Price Regulation and Environmental Externalities: Evidence from Methane Leaks
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We estimate expenditures by US natural gas distribution firms to reduce natural gas leaks. Reducing leaks averts commodity losses (valued at around $5/Mcf [thousand cubic feet]), but also climate damages ($27/Mcf) because the primary component of natural gas is methane, a potent greenhouse gas. In addition to this private/social wedge, incentives to abate are weakened by this industry’s status as a regulated natural monopoly: current price regulations allow many distribution firms to pass the cost of any leaked gas on to their customers. Our estimates imply that too little is spent repairing leaks—we estimate expenditures substantially below $5/Mcf, that is, less than the commodity value of the leaked gas. In contrast, expenditures on accelerated pipeline replacement are in general higher than the combination of gas costs and climate benefits (we estimate expenditures ranging from $48/Mcf to $211/Mcf). We conclude by relating these findings to regulatory-induced incentives in the industry.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了美国天然气配送企业为减少天然气泄漏而产生的支出。减少泄漏可以避免商品损失（价值约为每千立方英尺5美元［Mcf］），还可以避免气候损害（每Mcf 27美元），因为天然气的主要成分甲烷是一种强效温室气体。除了这一私人与社会成本之间的差距之外，该行业作为受管制的自然垄断行业的地位也削弱了减排激励：现行价格管制允许许多配送企业将泄漏天然气的成本转嫁给其客户。我们的估算表明，用于修复泄漏的支出太少——我们估计其支出远低于每Mcf 5美元，即低于泄漏天然气的商品价值。相比之下，加速管道更换的支出总体上高于天然气成本与气候效益之和（我们估计支出范围为每Mcf 48美元至211美元）。最后，我们将这些发现与行业中监管引发的激励联系起来。

title: Shock Value: Bill Smoothing and Energy Price Pass-Through
abstract: Energy prices are volatile, affect every consumer and industry in the economy, and are impacted by regulations including gas taxes and carbon pricing. Like the pass-through literature in general, the growing energy pass-through literature focuses on marginal prices. However, multi-part pricing is common in energy retail pricing.I examine the retail natural gas market, showing that while marginal prices exhibit full or nearly full pass-through, fixed fees exhibit negative pass-through. This is consistent with the stated desire by utilities and regulators to prevent "bill shock."I discuss implications for pass-through estimation and for proposed alternative pricing structures for regulated utilities.
abstract_zh: 能源价格波动剧烈，影响经济中的每一位消费者和每一个行业，并受到汽油税和碳定价等监管措施的影响。与一般的传导效应文献类似，日益增多的能源传导效应文献关注的是边际价格。然而，多部分定价在能源零售定价中十分常见。我考察了零售天然气市场，结果表明，尽管边际价格呈现完全或接近完全的传导，但固定费用却呈现负向传导。这与公用事业公司和监管机构希望防止“账单冲击”（bill shock）的既定意愿相一致。我还讨论了这一发现对传导效应估计的启示，以及对受管制公用事业公司拟议的替代定价结构的影响。

title: Regression Discontinuity in Time: Considerations for Empirical Applications
abstract: Recent empirical work in several economic fields, particularly environmental and energy economics, has adapted the regression discontinuity (RD) framework to applications where time is the running variable and treatment begins at a particular threshold in time. In this guide for practitioners, we discuss several features of this regression discontinuity in time framework that differ from the more standard cross-sectional RD framework. First, many applications (particularly in environmental economics) lack cross-sectional variation and are estimated using observations far from the temporal threshold. This common empirical practice is hard to square with the assumptions of a cross-sectional RD, which is conceptualized for an estimation bandwidth shrinking even as the sample size increases. Second, estimates may be biased if the time-series properties of the data are ignored (for instance, in the presence of an autoregressive process), or more generally if short-run and long-run effects differ. Finally, tests for sorting or bunching near the threshold are often irrelevant, making the framework closer to an event study than a regression discontinuity design. Based on these features and motivated by hypothetical examples using air quality data, we offer suggestions for the empirical researcher wishing to use the RD in time framework.
abstract_zh: 近期若干经济学领域的实证研究，尤其是环境与能源经济学，已将断点回归（RD）框架应用于以时间作为驱动变量、且处理在某一时间阈值开始的场景。在这份面向实践者的指南中，我们讨论了这一“时间断点回归”框架的若干特征，它们不同于更为标准的截面断点回归框架。第一，许多应用（尤其是环境经济学中的应用）缺乏截面变异，并使用远离时间阈值的观测值进行估计。这一常见的实证做法与截面断点回归的假设难以相容，后者的设想是估计带宽随样本量增加而收缩。第二，如果忽视数据的时间序列特性（例如存在自回归过程），或者更一般地说，如果短期效应与长期效应存在差异，估计结果可能会有偏。第三，阈值附近的分选或聚集检验往往并不相关，使得该框架更接近事件研究而非断点回归设计。基于这些特征，并以使用空气质量数据的假设性例子为动机，我们为希望使用时间断点回归框架的实证研究者提出了建议。

title: Climate Change is Projected to Have Severe Impact on the Frequency and Intensity of Peak Electricity Demand across the United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The existing empirical literature on the impacts of climate change on the electricity sector has focused on changing electricity consumption patterns. In this paper, we show that incorporating impacts on the frequency and intensity of peak load consumption during hot days implies sizable required investments in peak generating capacity (or major advances in storage technology or the structure of electricity prices), which results in substantially larger impacts than those from just changes in overall consumption.
abstract_zh: 现有关于气候变化对电力部门影响的实证文献，主要关注用电消费模式的变化。在本文中，我们表明，将高温日用电高峰负荷的频率和强度影响纳入考虑，意味着需要在峰值发电容量上进行大量投资（或在储能技术或电价结构方面取得重大进展），而由此产生的影响要远大于仅考虑总体用电量变化所带来的影响。

title: Market Impacts of a Nuclear Power Plant Closure
abstract: Falling revenues and rising costs have put US nuclear plants in financial trouble, and some threaten to close. To understand the potential private and social consequences, we examine the abrupt closure of the San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station (SONGS) in 2012. Using a novel econometric approach, we show that the lost generation from SONGS was met largely by increased in-state natural gas generation. In the twelve months following the closure, natural gas generation costs increased by $350 million. The closure also created binding transmission constraints, causing short-run inefficiencies and potentially making it more profitable for certain plants to act noncompetitively. (JEL D24, L25, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
abstract_zh: 收入下降和成本上升使美国核电厂陷入财务困境，部分电厂面临关闭的威胁。为了解其潜在的私人和社会后果，我们考察了2012年圣奥诺弗雷核电站（SONGS）的突然关闭。采用一种新颖的计量方法，我们发现，SONGS损失的发电量很大程度上由州内增加的天然气发电所补足。关闭后的十二个月内，天然气发电成本增加了3.5亿美元。关闭还产生了具有约束力的输电约束，导致短期效率低下，并可能使某些电厂更有利可图地采取非竞争性行为。（JEL D24, L25, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

title: Welfare and Distributional Implications of Shale Gas
abstract: Technological innovations in horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing have enabled tremendous amounts of natural gas to be extracted profitably from underground shale formations that were long thought to be uneconomical. In this paper, we provide the first estimates of broad-scale welfare and distributional implications of this supply boom. We provide new estimates of supply and demand elasticities, which we use to estimate the drop in natural gas prices that is attributable to the supply expansion. We find large, positive welfare impacts for four broad sectors of gas consumption (residential, commercial, industrial, and electric power) and a negative impact for producers, with variation across regions. We then examine the evidence for a gas-led “manufacturing renaissance” and for pass-through to prices of products such as retail natural gas, retail electricity, and commodity chemicals. We conclude with a discussion of environmental externalities from unconventional natural gas, including limitations of the current regulatory environment. Overall, we find that between 2007 and 2013 the shale gas revolution led to an increase in welfare for natural gas consumers and producers of $48 billion per year, but more data are needed on the extent and valuation of the environmental impacts of shale gas production.
abstract_zh: 水平钻井和水力压裂技术的创新，使得大量原本被认为不经济的页岩地层中的天然气得以盈利性开采。在本文中，我们首次对这一供给热潮的广泛福利和分配影响进行了估计。我们提供了供给和需求弹性的新估计，并利用这些弹性估算了可归因于供给扩张的天然气价格下降幅度。我们发现，天然气消费的四个主要部门（居民、商业、工业和电力）获得了较大的正向福利影响，而生产者则受到负面影响，且存在地区差异。随后，我们考察了天然气推动“制造业复兴”的证据，以及其向零售天然气、零售电力和大宗化学品等产品价格的传导（pass-through）。最后，我们讨论了非常规天然气带来的环境外部性，包括当前监管环境的局限性。总体而言，我们发现，2007年至2013年间，页岩气革命使天然气消费者和生产者的福利每年增加了480亿美元，但仍需要更多数据，以评估页岩气生产的环境影响及其价值。

title: Corporate Incentives and Nuclear Safety
abstract: Following electricity market restructuring, approximately half of all commercial US nuclear power reactors were sold by price-regulated public utilities to independent power producers. At the time of the sales, some policymakers raised concerns that these corporations would ignore safety. Others claimed that the sales would bring improved reactor management, with positive effects on safety. Using data on various safety measures and a difference-in-differences estimation strategy, I find that safety improved following ownership transfers and the removal of price regulations. Generation increased, and this does not appear to have come at the cost of public safety. (JEL D24, L51, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
abstract_zh: 在电力市场化改革之后，美国约一半的商用核电反应堆由受价格管制的公用事业公司出售给独立发电企业。在出售时，一些政策制定者担心这些公司会忽视安全问题。另一些人则认为，此次出售将带来更好的反应堆管理，从而对安全产生积极影响。利用各类安全指标的数据和双重差分估计策略，我发现所有权转移以及价格管制的取消之后，安全状况有所改善。发电量有所增加，而这似乎并未以公共安全为代价。（JEL D24, L51, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

title: Biofuels and Land Use Change: Sugarcane and Soybean Acreage Response in Brazil
Farm Acreage Shocks and Crop Prices: An SVAR Approach to Understanding the Impacts of Biofuels
abstract: The last ten years have seen tremendous expansion in biofuels production, particularly in corn ethanol in the United States, at the same time that commodity prices (e.g., corn) have experienced significant spikes. While supporters claim that biofuels are renewable and carbon-friendly, concerns have been raised about their impacts on land use and food prices. This paper analyzes how U.S. crop prices have responded to shocks in acreage supply; these shocks can be thought of as a shock to the residual supply of corn for food. Using a structural vector auto-regression framework, we examine shocks to a crop's own acreage and to total cropland. This allows us to estimate the effect of dedicating cropland or non-crop farmlands to biofuels feedstock production. A negative shock in own acreage leads to an increase in price for soybeans and corn. Our calculations show that increased corn ethanol production during the boom production year 2006/2007 explains approximately 27% of the experienced corn price rise.
abstract_zh: 过去十年，生物燃料产量经历了巨大扩张，尤其是美国的玉米乙醇，与此同时，玉米等大宗商品价格也经历了显著的飙升。尽管支持者称生物燃料是可再生且有利于气候的，但人们对其对土地利用和粮食价格的影响提出了担忧。本文分析了美国作物价格如何对耕地供给冲击作出反应；这些冲击可被视为对玉米用于食品的剩余供给的冲击。我们采用结构向量自回归框架，考察某一作物自身种植面积以及总耕地面积的冲击。这使我们能够估计将耕地或非耕地用于生产生物燃料原料的效应。某一作物种植面积的负向冲击会导致大豆和玉米价格上涨。我们的计算表明，2006/2007年生产繁荣期玉米乙醇产量的增加，解释了所经历的玉米价格上涨中约27%的部分。

title: An Anatomy of Trade in the 2008-09 Crisis
venue: Managing Openness: Trade and Outward-Oriented Growth after the Crisis
abstract: Proposes topics to consider explaining the role of demand- and supply-side factors in the fall of trade and the greater global financial crisis through an analysis of extensive and intensive margin; demand and supply side shocks; and changes in trends based on product type and income group. Analysis of changes in the extensive and intensive margin show that in 2009, imports to the United States and the EU dropped to $3 trillion from $4 trillion in 2009 and that for U.S. and French firms the changes in the intensive margin were greater than changes in the extensive margin. The effects of intensive margin changes included negative effects for prices and quantities, which makes sense for a demand shock. Disaggregated data in the manufacturing sector intimate that prices increased in many areas, indicating a supply-side effect. Exports from low-income countries to Brazil and Indonesia increased by almost 30 percent from 2008 to 2009 while decreases in access to credit resulted in higher prices in relevant U.S. sectors.

title: Decomposing the Great Trade Collapse: Products, Prices and Quantities in 2007-2009
